responsibility: Implements a cleanup RTL pass for the Epiphany backend’s floating-point mode switching. After earlier mode-switch analysis and USE insertion, it resolves set_fp_mode instructions whose requested rounding mode is still FP_MODE_ROUND_UNKNOWN, choosing a concrete mode when liveness makes only one mode necessary and otherwise inserting compensating mode-setting sequences on CFG edges where the alternate rounding mode becomes required. It thus finalizes the backend’s FP rounding-mode control before later RTL stages.
